description.value: Drawing on a group's deepest fears, you conjure phantom horrors visible only to them. Every creature within a 30-foot-radius sphere becomes frightened for the duration. At the end of each affected creature's turn, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 5d10 psychic damage; success ends the power for that creature. Droids and constructs are unaffected.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 9
